# Softmake IT Solutions

Softmake.in engineers premium, scalable, and secure custom software systems, business applications, and ERP integrations.

## Primary Capabilities

- **Web Application Development**: Custom high-performance web systems and Progressive Web Apps (PWAs).
- **Mobile Engineering**: Native iOS/Android apps and cross-platform Flutter development.
- **Enterprise Integrations**: SAP, Microsoft 365, Zoho One implementation, integration middleware, and WhatsApp Business API.
- **Custom Business Platforms**: Custom ERPs, CRM systems, HR Management, and Inventory/Billing software.
